scope: Guarded proposals from existing weak reviews; not annotations, training admission or semantic proof
literalRule: After routing/whitespace/case/digit normalization, permit only numeric/mask slots and a uniquely located weak legacy name claim. Every other character must match the reviewed representative.
slotRiskRule: Changed name/biller slots containing financial, negation, conditional or ownership wording require manual review; name claims are untrusted locators, not labels.
primaryAmountRule: For completed descendants, locate the representative's reviewed amount numeric-slot index and require a positive finite plain-decimal value in that child slot. No amount label is emitted.
deduplicationRule: Deduplicate identical normalized training text only; prefer the directly reviewed representative. Conflicting proposed targets hold the duplicate set out. This is not transaction-event deduplication.
weightRule: Each source expression has total proposed weight1 per head; weights describe sampling, never certainty.
admissionRule: All proposal records remain trainingEligible=false and independentEvaluationEligible=false; validation references have no target labels.
